title: Editor Large Structure Performance Gate Checklist

items.label: Capture Project Control, terminology, Editor owner, and old roadmap context before implementation.
items.evidenceTarget: Project Control entrypoint, Work path, owner repository, active role, current phase, checklist target, evidence target, terminology docs, Editor AGENTS.md, and the old large-document performance task are identified before editing.
items.verificationNote: Identified Work path flowdoc-product-development-resumption > flowdoc-core-backend-editor-readiness-pass-8h, owner repository repo-editor, Project Control record owner repo-project-control, phase target phase-flowdoc-core-backend-editor-readiness-pass-editor-large-structure-performance-gate, checklist target checklist-flowdoc-core-backend-editor-readiness-pass-editor-large-structure-performance-gate, and evidence target evidence-editor-large-structure-performance-gate-2026-08-31.

items.label: Write failing performance evidence tests before accepting the gate.
items.evidenceTarget: The focused Editor performance test fails before replayable fixture evidence exists.
items.verificationNote: RED evidence included npm run test -- src/tests/editorLargeStructurePerformance.test.ts failing because src/fixtures/editor-large-structure-smoke.v1.json did not exist.

items.label: Generate replayable local synthetic large-structure fixture evidence.
items.evidenceTarget: The smoke script creates src/fixtures/editor-large-structure-smoke.v1.json with 100, 1000, and 5000 visible-node samples.
items.verificationNote: scripts/run-editor-large-structure-smoke.mjs generated fixture version editor-large-structure-smoke-v1 with 100, 1000, and 5000 visible text-block structure samples.

items.label: Measure 1000-node hard thresholds for projection, add actions, selection plus zoom, and Structure rendering.
items.evidenceTarget: The 1000-node sample stays within the hard limits for projection, add-action projection, selection plus zoom, Structure render time, Structure markup size, and rendered Structure row count.
items.verificationNote: The 1000 visible-node fixture recorded render projection 7.527ms, add-action projection 62.878ms, selection plus zoom projection 0.126ms, Structure render 89.266ms, 66298 markup bytes, and 61 rendered Structure rows.

items.label: Keep the 5000-node scenario exploratory and bounded.
items.evidenceTarget: The 5000-node sample is recorded as exploratory local synthetic evidence and does not promote broad readiness.
items.verificationNote: The 5000 visible-node fixture recorded render projection 11.183ms, add-action projection 143.814ms, Structure render 117.022ms, 66492 markup bytes, 61 rendered Structure rows, and no soft threshold exceeded list while remaining explicitly exploratory.

items.label: Verify the merged Editor main state and no-write replay.
items.evidenceTarget: Merged Editor main passes the full check and the no-write performance smoke replay.
items.verificationNote: Merged Editor main passed npm run check with 108 test files, 391 tests, and build. FLOWDOC_EVIDENCE_WRITE=0 node scripts/run-editor-large-structure-smoke.mjs passed with the recorded fixture metrics and did not rewrite fixture evidence.

items.label: Record the bounded result in Project Control without promoting map truth.
items.evidenceTarget: Project Control records the phase, checklist, and evidence target for the large Structure performance gate while preserving the bounded risk statements.
items.verificationNote: Project Control record tests require the phase, checklist, evidence, Editor merge commit, 1000-node metrics, 5000-node exploratory wording, and WYSIWYG exclusion. The Project Control worktree passed the focused roadmap test with 1 file and 2 tests, then npm run check passed check:data, type-check, 59 Vitest files with 330 tests, build, and 6 Playwright e2e tests.
